Values marked candidate are not frozen. Nothing in this file starts, configures, authorizes, dispatches, or freezes a campaign; no executor run is a measured experiment on the strength of this file.

category_meanings.ARRIVED_IDENTITY_READ: the execution reached the authenticated catalogue and the identity of the first catalogue position was read (identity_oracle item_identity)
category_meanings.ARRIVED_ARRIVAL_ONLY: the execution reached the authenticated catalogue; the identity oracle of this surface is arrival_only, so no identity was read by design
category_meanings.ARRIVED_IDENTITY_UNREADABLE: the execution reached the authenticated catalogue but the identity of the first position could not be read (identity_oracle item_identity); recorded with its reason, never excluded
category_meanings.NOT_ARRIVED_INFRASTRUCTURE: the execution did not reach the authenticated catalogue because of the infrastructure (backend refusal, backend unavailability, or a cold-start or device timeout), recorded with its message, never repaired and never excluded silently (D-E06-8)
category_meanings.NOT_ARRIVED_SUT: the system under test answered and did not let the actor reach the authenticated catalogue (for example a refused credential)
category_meanings.NOT_ARRIVED_RUNNER: a fault of the executor, the browser, the WebDriver client, or the Appium session stopped the execution before its record was complete; attributed to TOOLING

identity_oracle_switch.scope: per condition (per surface); the value is fixed in the locked configuration before the START; the executor refuses to start a condition whose value differs from the value named in the configuration passed to it (environment variable EXPECTED_IDENTITY_ORACLE). arrival_only is the DP-3 fallback recorded before the START when a non-measured DRY_RUN shows that the identity cannot be read on that surface.

pairing_rule: Paired per index: execution k of the WEB condition of an ecosystem is paired with execution k of its ANDROID condition (same account, same market, same index), k = 1 to 50.
parity_rule: Parity is present for pair k when both executions reach the authenticated catalogue AND the identity of the first catalogue position is the same on both surfaces. An execution that did not arrive is recorded with its reason and is a non-parity; it is never excluded after the fact and never retried inside the same execution record.
estimand: Parity proportion per ecosystem = pairs with parity over 50, with a Wilson 95% interval; effect SUT-01 versus SUT-02 by risk difference with an interval and Fisher's exact test (protocol/statistical-analysis-plan-v1.md, section 4.3). SUT-01 versus SUT-03 has no mobile data and is not estimable. The analysis is not part of this executor.

viewport_policy.identity_suffix_rule: the SUT-01 web test identifiers carry -desktop when the viewport width is at least 768 px and -responsive below it (frontend/src/hooks/useResponsive.js); the suffix is stripped before the pizza id is compared, and the raw identifier is recorded beside the normalized one

open_items: 1. SUT-02 Android account: the candidate is the first documented quick-pick pair of the pinned layout (bod@example.com / 10203040). The pairing rule asks for the same account on both surfaces; the alternative is standard_user / secret_sauce, which the app accepts (SUT02-EV-0007). The human research lead decides before the lock.

2. SUT-01 web application: the API origin of the hosted web build is not recorded in an E01 row; DRY_RUN must show which backend the web surface uses (D-E06-8 assumes the same hosted backend for both surfaces).

3. SUT-01 web root route and the test identifiers of the sign-in form are taken from the pinned source; every web selector is to be verified by a non-measured DRY_RUN against the hosted deployment (which is unpinned).
4. environment_type of SUT-02 web (PUBLIC_HOSTED proposed by analogy with D-E06-8) and of SUT-02 Android (EMULATED proposed) are not decided.

5. The SUT-01 Android testID of a React Native view may map to the resource id or to the accessibility label on the emulator; the accessibility-label strategy is used because the source sets it (qa.ts), and a DRY_RUN must show that the card labels are exposed with the expected count.
6. SUT-02 has no market or language parameter in the sources read; market and language are recorded as null for both SUT-02 conditions.

7. identity_oracle per surface is item_identity for all four conditions (default). arrival_only is the DP-3 fallback, to be recorded before the START only if a DRY_RUN shows that the item identity cannot be read on a surface.
8. The Android drawer row Log In is at position 10 of the drawer list (MainActivity.java lines 256 to 259); whether it is on screen without a scroll is a DRY_RUN question.
9. Whether the arrival of SUT-02 Android should also read the Logout Menu Item row (MainActivity.java line 257) as a second signal of the authenticated state is a choice for the human research lead.

10. Analysis rule for ARRIVED_IDENTITY_UNREADABLE: the parity rule counts an unreadable identity as not equal; whether it stays a non-parity or is a separate category in the analysis is a decision for the analysis plan (not decided here).

11. Duration: 50 sequential clean installs per Android condition may not fit a single GitHub job; the measured workflow sets the job budget at the maximum allowed, and the real duration is a DRY_RUN observation.

12. executor_implementation_sha256, executor_prompt_version and the dispatch authorization identifiers are null until the configuration is locked and the authorizations are issued (protocol/agent-governance-v6.md, Section 3.7).
13. The documented test password pizza123 and the SUT-02 password secret_sauce appear in this draft because they are documented in the pinned sources; the executor scrubs them from every kept file.
